    static class BigNumber {
        String add(String s1, String s2) {
            int n1 = s1.length(), n2 = s2.length();
            ArrayList<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            int i = n1 - 1, j = n2 - 1;
            while (i >= 0 && j >= 0) {
                int a = (s1.charAt(i) - '0') + (s2.charAt(j) - '0');
                v.add(a);
                i--; j--;
            }
            while (i >= 0) {
                v.add(s1.charAt(i) - '0');
                i--;
            }
            while (j >= 0) {
                v.add(s2.charAt(j) - '0');
                j--;
            }
            int carry = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                carry += v.get(k);
                if (carry >= 10) {
                    v.set(k, carry - 10);
                    carry = 1;
                } else {
                    v.set(k, carry);
                    carry = 0;
                }
            }
            if (carry > 0) v.add(carry);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int k = v.size() - 1; k >= 0; k--) sb.append((char)(v.get(k) + '0'));
            sb.append('\n');
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    static class PrimeNumber {
        int N;
        boolean[] NP;
        ArrayList<Integer> P;

        long _powmod(long a, long b) {
            if (b == 0) return 1;
            if ((b & 1) == 1) return a * _powmod(a, b - 1) % MOD;
            return _powmod(a * a % MOD, b / 2);
        }

        PrimeNumber() {}

        PrimeNumber(int n) {
            N = n;
            NP = new boolean[N + 4];
            P = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP[i]) continue;
                for (int j = i * i; j <= N; j += i) NP[j] = true;
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) if (!NP[i]) P.add(i);
        }

        long gcd(long x, long y) {
            long z;
            while (x != 0) {
                z = y % x;
                y = x;
                x = z;
            }
            return y;
        }

        long powermod(long p, long q) {
            long g = gcd(p, q);
            p /= g;
            q /= g;
            return p * _powmod(q, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> factorization(int x) {
            ArrayList<Integer> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            if (x == 1) {
                ret.add(1);
                return ret;
            }
            ret.add(1);
            ret.add(x);
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) {
                    ret.add(i);
                    ret.add(x / i);
                }
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret.add(i);
            return ret;
        }

        int factorization2(int x) {
            if (x == 1) return 1;
            int ret = 2;
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) ret += 2;
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret++;
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Comb {

            init(n);

        void init(int n) {
            N = n;
            C = new long[N + 1][];
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C[i] = new long[i + 1];
                C[i][i] = C[i][0] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
                    C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            F = new long[N + 1];
            F[0] = F[1] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) F[i] = (F[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
        }

        long getC(int n, int r) {
            return C[n][r];
        }

        long getF(int n) {
            return F[n];
        }

        long get_comb(int n, int r) {
            if (n == r || r == 0) return 1;
            if (n <= 1000) return getC(n, r);
            long ret = 1;
            if (r > n / 2) r = n - r;
            for (int i = n; i > n - r; i--) ret *= i;
            for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) ret /= i;
            return ret;
        }
    }

            if (lo >= hi) return;
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            merge_sort(x, lo, mid);
            merge_sort(x, mid + 1, hi);
            int i = lo, j = mid + 1, k = lo;
            while (i <= mid && j <= hi) {
                if (x[i] < x[j]) tmp[k++] = x[i++];
                else tmp[k++] = x[j++];
            }
            while (i <= mid) tmp[k++] = x[i++];
            while (j <= hi) tmp[k++] = x[j++];
            for (i = lo; i <= hi; i++) x[i] = tmp[i];
        }
    }

    static class SegmentTree2D {
        int[][] P;
        int N, M;
        Point[] T;

        SegmentTree2D(int n, int m) {
            N = n;
            M = m;

        Point build(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2) {
            if (a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();
            if (a1 == a2 && b1 == b2) return T[node] = new Point(a1, b1, P[a1][b1]);
            T[node] = def();
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2));
            return T[node];
        }

        Point query(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {

        Point _query(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
            if (x1 > a2 || y1 > b2 || x2 < a1 || y2 < b1 || a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();
            if (x1 <= a1 && y1 <= b1 && a2 <= x2 && b2 <= y2) return T[node];
            Point mx = def();
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            return mx;
        }

        Point _update(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x, int y, int value) {

            if (x > a2 || y > b2 || x < a1 || y < b1) return T[node];
            if (x == a1 && y == b1 && x == a2 && y == b2) return T[node] = new Point(x, y, value);

            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x, y, value));
